B is better. Both identify the same core issues, including the `Invalidate` read-lock bug, which is the most important one. B is closer to the 200-word limit, at roughly 215 words against A's roughly 265, and A's opening sentence is filler. B also adds the accurate point that Go's concurrent-map-write fault cannot be recovered. Its weakest item, "errors aren't cached," is minor, but A has no comparable advantage that offsets the length overrun.

B
